question: Does the original split-leaf AAI test estimate a sufficiently narrow short-term effect to exclude biologically meaningful differences in 24-hour 3rd-instar growth/consumption, when paired leaves and unobserved fates are respected?
source: Hashimoto Ohgushi 2023 Figshare 23170898, original larval CSV md5 982d4931da306a7ff8e8d550cffe5246; leafarea md5 ebe8c2404d9a13b73f08c16ecb9ddc22

prior_known_inventory.design: 30 split leaves per butterfly species, 60 larvae of each species with 30 AAI and 30 control
prior_known_inventory.discrepant_record: a4 original leaf half side r,l in larvae table versus r,r in leaf area; leaf ID and larva ID agree

estimand: Within EACH species separately, average (AAI − control) normalized 24h growth and consumption for leaves with both caterpillars documented and loss=0, each original leaf contributes once; complete-pair analysis is selected on post-assignment survival.
consumption_ratio: consumed.leaf.area / initial.mass per larva (units inherited from authors; not a true calibrated assimilation efficiency)
unpaired_sensitivity: Report AAI minus control all-observed means with independent source leaf-cluster bootstrapped confidence interval. Distinguish from complete-pair contrast. No posthoc trimming of negative growth.
bootstrap: 9999 within-species resamples of leaf IDs with replacement, seed 20261010, repeat for each endpoint; 95% empirical percentile interval.
fate_reporting: Report all 120 original assigned larvae and 21 original loss=1 codes, in both treatment groups. These are author 'haphazardly dead' losses excluded in original analysis; NOT independently diagnosed toxicological mortality and cannot be treated as random missing at will.
equivalence: No equivalence/absence-of-effect claim merely because interval contains zero; no biological equivalence margin fixed independently of outcomes. State CI and original prior art.
eligibility: Source CSV MD5, one unique h.id in each table, treatment/leaf ID match through h.id, two treated/control records per source leaf, one species per leaf; do not force the single original half-label typo to exact-match.
not_identified: effect on introduced host plant range
